data_restrictions: MIT License, per the dataset repository.
reference_mapping_status: Centers.txt holds the 10,000 reference strands and Clusters.txt holds the reads in the same cluster order. benchmarks/convert_cnr_to_physical.py writes a subset as reference and read FASTA files; the evaluator then assigns each read to its nearest reference by edit distance, not by cluster index.
notes: Provenance only; the data is not bundled. CNR strands were not encoded with OligoArk, so results are reference-reconstruction accuracy, not an end-to-end decoding claim. See docs/external-cnr-benchmark.md for the separate pinned BBS comparison.
